posts.title: The Sensor Who Cried Rain !
posts.description: Let me tell you a story. A story of sensors, rain, and the long, bumpy road to getting a window to politely tell me: “Hey, close me. It’s about to pour.” This was the idea: a weather-aware window sensor that could detect if a window was open, check if rain was incoming, and send an alert.
